title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Refund Ledger Standard: Refund Tender and What a Refund Carries
content:
This ledger standard of Northgate Purchases & Returns states, per channel, where a refund is paid and which related amounts travel with a returned line.

| Channel | Original tenders refunded on a Northgate Shop Card instead | Returned unit already price-adjusted is refunded at its adjusted price | Non-member surcharge on a returned line refunded with it | Return reasons that refund the delivery fee when the order ends fully returned |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | Shop Card; reward certificate | yes | yes | none |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | Shop Card; reward certificate | yes | yes | none |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | Shop Card; reward certificate | yes | yes | none |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | Shop Card; reward certificate | yes | yes | defective; not as described; damaged in transit; not received |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | Shop Card; reward certificate | yes | yes | none |
| Northgate Special Order | Shop Card; reward certificate | yes | yes | none |

## Standard notes

1. **Tender.** A purchase paid with a Shop Card or a reward certificate is refunded on a Northgate Shop Card; every other tender is refunded to itself. The same terms hold on all six channels.
2. **Adjusted units.** On all six channels a returned unit that already received a price adjustment is refunded at its adjusted price, not its sale price.
3. **Surcharge.** On all six channels the non-member surcharge on a returned line is refunded with that line.
4. **Delivery fee.** Only the Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order lists reasons that refund the delivery fee; on that channel the fee comes back when the order ends fully returned and every refund on it carried one of the four reasons listed. A changed-mind or missing-parts refund on the order is not among them.

Hypothetical reading: a Ship-to-Home order paid by debit card, returned in full as not received, is refunded to the debit card together with its delivery fee.
